name: Dembrandt Skills
evidence: 118★ · created Apr 2026 · 100 commits Aug–Oct 2026 · MIT · 45 skills · same team as Dembrandt (3.7k★)
summary: First declined as too young. After reading the skills, I reversed that: each one cites its standard (WCAG 2.2, EN 301 549), gives concrete rules (state colors derived in HSL, six button states), and ships trigger metadata so agents load only what's relevant. It fills a UX-judgment gap nothing else on the list covers. The low star count reflects age, not quality.

name: Dembrandt
evidence: 3.7k★ · 11 months old · active · MIT · CLI + MCP server
summary: Best at one clear job: extracting a live site's design system into Tailwind, shadcn or W3C tokens. Proven adoption and active releases.

name: App Store Screenshots
summary: Narrow but clearly the best at it: a store-ready screenshot pipeline for every required size, with a real accepted App Store listing as proof.

name: genjutsu
evidence: 570★ · 7 months · active · MIT · published run transcripts and costs
summary: Unusually transparent: it publishes full transcripts and costs of real runs. Its approve-a-plan-first workflow for motion is distinctive. Mostly one maintainer, so it gets re-reviewed next quarter.

name: Responsively App
summary: Not AI, so at first it was out of scope. Added once the Companion Tools category existed: it's the fastest way to verify AI-generated UI on every screen size.

name: Awwwards MCP
evidence: 196★ · 1 month · 99% of commits from one person · scrapes awwwards.com
summary: Impressive 25-tool design-reference MCP, but too new and built on scraping a third-party site.

name: Brag
summary: Viral launch-video skill. Waiting to see whether maintenance and quality outlast the hype.
